Ram Mandir Trust Faces Scrutiny Over Donation Irregularities

A Special Investigation Team (SIT) has submitted a report to the Uttar Pradesh government concerning alleged irregularities in donations received for the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. The report, which follows an investigation into allegations of donation theft and mismanagement, has raised questions about the functioning of the temple trust. The SIT has recommended further action and requested more time for a detailed investigation.
